## What

Brief description of the change.

## Why

What problem does this solve or what improvement does it make?

## Type of Change

- [ ] New skill or command
- [ ] Enhancement to an existing skill or command
- [ ] New or updated template
- [ ] Bug fix (installer, hook, extension, report generator)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Infrastructure / tooling change

## Testing

- [ ] `pre-commit run --all-files` passes locally
- [ ] If adding or modifying a **skill**: tested manually in Claude Code (describe below)
- [ ] If adding or modifying a **command**: verified the command prompt runs end-to-end
- [ ] If adding or modifying a **hook**: tested on both Write and Edit tool calls as applicable
- [ ] If modifying the **installer**: tested on Windows (PS1) and/or macOS/Linux (Bash) as applicable
- [ ] If modifying **templates**: reviewed rendered output in target AI assistant

## Manual Test Description

(Describe what you tested and the result. For skills, show the skill trigger and a sample output.)

## Notes

Any additional context for reviewers — breaking changes, open questions, follow-up work.
